title: epan: Remove trailing comma after HFILL invocations.
description:
Some dissectors have included an unnecessary trailing comma after some HFILL
macro invocations.  It's harmless but untidy.

Remove those trailing commas.

(cherry picked from commit c039bb94f92f8130f576321dcee7a694f7eeab68)

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

commits_data.message:
epan: Remove trailing comma after HFILL invocations.

Some dissectors have included an unnecessary trailing comma after some HFILL
macro invocations.  It's harmless but untidy.

Remove those trailing commas.

(cherry picked from commit c039bb94f92f8130f576321dcee7a694f7eeab68)
